_original_lore: Ghasts are mobs found in the northern end of
the Blazing Fortress at nighttime (8:30 PM - 5:00
AM skyblock time) in the sky within the zone where
level 9 Magma Cubes spawn, or the Magma Cube Boss.
It can also be spawned from Ghast Minions.
